All three inverse-drift items are now reconciled so a strict `Schema.parse()` holds:

- **dashboard** `component`/`data`/`rowField`/`columnField` — ✅ already resolved on `main`: `component`/`data` + the pre-ADR-0021 inline-analytics keys are quarantined and rejected by the strict `DashboardWidgetSchema` error map (`dashboard.zod.ts`), which points authors at `dataset` + `dimensions`/`values` (renderer-only extras → `options`).
- **app** `accentColor`/`badgeVariant`/`separator` — ✅ already resolved on `main`: all three declared on `AppSchema` (`app.zod.ts`).
- **view** `ObjectView` form-adapter keys — the last open piece, now done. The structured `buttons`/`defaults` (added to `FormViewSchema` under #2998 Track A) were still `experimental` because no renderer read them. Fixed as a co-landed pair:
  - **objectui** objectstack-ai/objectui#2790 — `ObjectForm` folds `buttons`/`defaults` onto its flat renderer props (`ObjectView` + `RecordFormPage` forward them); flat keys kept as deprecated back-compat.
  - **framework** #3417 — flips `view.form.buttons` / `view.form.defaults` `experimental → live` in the liveness ledger, drops the ADR-0078 markers, updates the audit docs. The remaining flat adapter keys (`customFields`/`className`/`fields`) stay classified renderer-only ObjectUI extensions, not spec surface (objectui#2545).

Both PRs are up as drafts and verified green locally (spec liveness gate; objectui type-check + DOM suites). CI is currently red only due to a GitHub Actions runner-allocation outage (every job failing at provisioning with `runner_id: 0`), which I'm re-running once runners recover. Part of umbrella #1878.
